description: Start or run a bounded preview for one saved amendment or one seller-selected draft. Returns customer-safe per-channel impact counts and status evidence, with no raw inventory rows or demand telemetry. Preview is not publication.

amendment.description: Draft amendment; provide this or amendmentId.

enabled.description: Whether the draft is enabled for preview.

channels.description: Specific marketplace channels for this amendment.

mode.description: Preview absolute multiplier and protected band.

multiplier.description: Absolute multiplier applied by this amendment. Required.
Protected multiplier at or above the threshold.

thresholdUsd.description: Original market anchor threshold in USD.

originalAnchorPriceBand.description: Optional original market anchor band selector.

maxUsd.description: Protected band upper bound in USD.

minUsd.description: Protected band lower bound in USD.

scryfallId.description: Exact Scryfall printing selector. Requires setCode when supplied.

amendmentId.description: The exact saved amendment id from a prior amendment read. Required.

context.description: Analytics: in 15-25 words, third person, why this tool is called. No prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers or arguments. Keep private tasks general.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_pricing_amendment_preview
